name: B7·1 Finance & Accounting Suite — e-invoice IRN + Zoho Books sync + daily reconciliation (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step (GSP/API accounts involved)
**A. E-invoice (IRN) via GSP:**
1. E-invoicing is mandatory above the AATO threshold — confirm applicability with your CA.
2. Register on einvoice1.gst.gov.in → API access via a GSP (ClearTax/Masters India/Zoho). Easiest: **Zoho Books' built-in e-invoicing** — then you only need step B and IRN happens inside Zoho automatically.
3. Direct-GSP route: get GSP base URL + auth → fill the 'GSP: generate IRN' node (it sends the standard INV-01 schema built from your Orders row).

**B. Zoho Books sync:**
1. Zoho API console (api-console.zoho.in) → Self Client → generate refresh token with scope `ZohoBooks.fullaccess.all` → add n8n OAuth2 credential (accounts.zoho.in token URL).
2. Variable **ZB_ORG_ID** (Zoho Books → Settings → Org ID).
3. Every new Orders row (marked Synced≠yes) → pushed as a Zoho invoice nightly; row marked back.

**C. Daily reconciliation (22:00):** compares Orders total vs Razorpay settlements (key from B3·2) for the day → any mismatch → 🔴 alert; else ✅ 'books match'.

## 🔧 FIX
• Zoho 401 → refresh token scope or wrong DC (.in vs .com).
• IRN rejected → GSTIN/HSN mandatory: gold jewellery HSN 7113, GST 3%.
• Recon always mismatching → COD orders settle via courier not Razorpay; the code already separates Payment='COD'.
